arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
sahihInternational: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
yusufAli: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
urdu: دن کے وقت تو تمہیں اور بہت سے شغل ہوتے ہیں

sahihInternational: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
yusufAli: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
urdu: اور ان کی جو تیرتے پھرتے ہیں
